How to make Chole Bhature at home with simple tips and tricks! masaledar chhole aur 100% phule hue bhature kaise banayen.to is bar chhutti ke din garma-garam phule hue bhature ke sath chatapte chhole aur achar parosiye aur bataeeyega ki kaise lage.
Ingredients for Chhole-Bhature
For Bhature
Maida - Refined Flour - 2 cup (250g)
Suji - Semolina - ½ cup (80g)
Dahi - Curd - ¼ cup
Namak - Salt - ½ tsp
Chini - Sugar - ½ tsp
